try {
  console.table({}, "x" as any);
} catch (error: any) {
  console.log(error instanceof TypeError, error.name, error.code);
  const wrapper = Object.getPrototypeOf(error);
  const formatter = Object.getPrototypeOf(wrapper);
  console.log(Object.hasOwn(wrapper, "toString"), Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(wrapper, "toString")?.enumerable);
  console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(wrapper), Object.getOwnPropertyNames(formatter));
  console.log(Object.getPrototypeOf(formatter) === TypeError.prototype, error.constructor === TypeError);
  console.log(Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(formatter)[0].description);
  console.log(String(error));
  error.code = "custom";
  console.log(String(error));
  console.log(Error.prototype.toString.call(error));
}
const ordinary = new TypeError("message") as TypeError & { code: string };
ordinary.code = "ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE";
console.log(String(ordinary));
try {
  console.table({}, null as any);
} catch (error: any) {
  error.code = "custom-headline";
  throw error;
}
